fusions.name: Pulled Thread
fusions.desc: Snags a thread of the target's guard and pulls, dealing 4 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Weighted Net
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed net over a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything caught in it and stunning it for 0.8 seconds, with a 60% chance per hit to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Curved-Needle Suture
fusions.desc: Stitches your wounds shut and restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Row by Row
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 7. At 7 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (29% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
